title: TruthLens
intro: Paste a message someone forwarded to you, then press the arrow. You will see whether it looks true or false, and why.
too_long: Message is too long (4,000 characters at most)
error_server: TruthLens could not finish checking this message.
unsupported: TruthLens works with English, Hindi and Punjabi.
band_title: Confidence {value}, calibrated on the development set
template_note: Couldn't generate an explanation that the sources back up, so this one lists them directly.
explanation_fallback: Explanation in English — {lang} explanations aren't available yet.
input_translit: {lang}, typed in Roman script → converted to {script}
notaclaim_note: TruthLens only checks factual claims. Greetings, opinions and predictions have nothing to verify.
manipulation_title: Persuasion techniques spotted in the message. They never change the verdict.
unchecked: {n} more claims in this message were not checked
unchecked_one: 1 more claim in this message was not checked
disclaimer: TruthLens can be wrong. Check the sources.
live_privacy: This sends only this claim to Wikipedia and Google.
live_unavailable: Online search isn't available right now, so the earlier answer stays.
live_attribution: Wikipedia text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0.
live_uncalibrated: Confidence for online results has not been calibrated.
live_verdict_basis: This verdict comes from Wikipedia text, read by two models that had to agree.
live_validated: In a test on 350 claims it was right 94% of the time when it gave a verdict, and it gave one for only about 3 claims in 10.
live_no_verdict: The two models did not agree, or were not sure enough, so there is no verdict. Read the sources.

fast_title.Conflicting: Fact-checkers say: partly true or misleading

reason.Refuted: The sources I found say this is not right.
reason.Supported: The sources I found agree with this.
reason.Conflicting: The sources I found do not agree with each other.
reason.NEI: I could not find enough to decide.
reason.abstained_Supported: It looks true, but I am not sure.
reason.abstained_Refuted: It looks false, but I am not sure.
reason.abstained_other: I could not find enough to be sure.
reason.live_none: I looked online too, and it is still hard to say. Here is what I found.
reason.live_Supported: I looked it up online and the sources agree with this.
reason.live_Refuted: I looked it up online and the sources say this is not right.
reason.careful: I couldn't find a source that checks this exact claim. Most messages like this turn out to be false.
reason.careful_live: I looked online too and still couldn't find a source that checks this exact claim. Most messages like this turn out to be false.

action.Supported: It looks true, but check the source before you forward it.
action.check: Please check before you forward it.

plain.none_title: I didn't find a claim to check
plain.none_note: I couldn't find a full claim to check here. If you meant a claim, write it as a full sentence, for example “The exam paper was leaked.”
plain.copy_failed: Could not copy. Please select the text yourself.

reply.Refuted: I checked this message with TruthLens: it looks FALSE. Please don't forward it.
reply.Supported: I checked this message with TruthLens: it looks true. Please check the source before you forward it.
reply.check: I checked this message with TruthLens: I could not confirm it. Please check before you forward it.
reply.similar: I checked this message with TruthLens: a fact-checker looked at something similar and rated it {rating}. Please read it before you forward this.
reply.similar_unrated: I checked this message with TruthLens: a fact-checker looked at something similar. Please read it before you forward this.

technique.Appeal_to_Authority: say an important person or group agrees

plain.no_exact: I couldn't find a source that checks this exact claim.
plain.related_label: The closest things I found (they may not be about this claim):
plain.try_online: To get a real answer, look it up online.

similar.reason: {publisher} looked at something similar and rated it {rating}. This may not be the same message.
similar.action: Please read it before you forward this.
similar.label: The fact-check:
similar.reason_unrated: {publisher} looked at something similar. This may not be the same message.

plain.greeting_note: This looks like a greeting or a good wish. There's nothing here to check.

words.title: These words pushed the answer the most:
words.hint: The marked words are the ones that changed the answer most.
words.note_english: These are the words of the English version of your message.
words.source: This sentence in the source mattered most:
words.unavailable: I couldn't show this right now.

why.label: Why: this is what the source says

lean_note: The system's own lean, which is NOT reliable for free text: {label}.
